boundsSemantics: [a,b) is half-open; explicit inclusive equivalents appear where important

capsule.interpretation: organic bright distractor; identical to stripe in the sampled local footprint, not evidence of path identity

maskEncoding: row-major uint8 exactly 0 or 1; 1 means hidden; mask area is literal pixel count, not bilinearly expanded sample support
pixelCoordinates: 0-based integer pixel centers (x,y); flattened row-major i=y*384+x; RGBA byte offset=4*i
raster: uint8 RGBA interleaved, background RGB100, bright RGB145, alpha255 everywhere; no antialiasing or compositing
